intro: Add many customers at once from an Excel or CSV file.

get.lead: Download the form, fill in one line for each set-top box, save it, then upload it in the next step.
get.other_language: Same form with Hindi column names:
get.rule_line: One line for each set-top box (VC). A customer with 2 boxes: 2 lines with the same customer code.
get.rule_needed: Customer code and Name are needed. Other columns can be empty.
get.rule_plan: For each box write the VC number and the plan name, or the rent in rupees.
get.rule_date: Start day like 15/10/2026. Empty means today.
get.rule_area: Areas must already be in Settings → Areas.
get.rule_again: Customers already in the app are not changed, so uploading the same file again is safe.
get.limits: Up to {rows} lines and {size} MB in one file.

file_error.too_big: The file is too big. Keep it under {size} MB, or split it into two files.
file_error.too_many_lines: The file has more than {rows} lines. Split it into two files.
file_error.empty: No customers found in the file.
file_error.unreadable: This file can't be read. Save it as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV and try again.
file_error.old_excel: This is an old Excel file (.xls). In Excel choose Save As → Excel Workbook (.xlsx).
file_error.no_header: The column names were not found. Use our form, or put the column names in the first line.
file_error.read_only: View only. Customers can't be added until the app subscription is paid.
file_error.not_allowed: You can't do this. Ask the owner.
file_error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing was added. Try again.

warning.not_utf8: Hindi letters may be lost in this file. In Excel choose Save As → CSV UTF-8, or upload the .xlsx file.

summary.ready: {count, plural, one {# customer ready to add} other {# customers ready to add}}
summary.exists: {count, plural, one {# already in the app: not changed} other {# already in the app: not changed}}
summary.problem: {count, plural, one {# customer has a problem: not added} other {# customers have a problem: not added}}
summary.created: {count, plural, one {# customer added} other {# customers added}}

check.problems_hint: Download them, fix the cells, and upload that file again.
check.download_failed: The file could not be made. Try again.

done.title: Done
done.stopped: The import stopped. Upload the same file again to add the rest: customers already added are skipped.

code.required: Customer code is empty. Every customer needs one.

name.required: Name is empty. Write it on the customer's first line.
name.name_differs: Line {line} has this customer code with another name. A different customer needs a different code.

phone.invalid: Mobile no. is not a phone number.

alt_phone.invalid: Other mobile no. is not a phone number.

area.not_found: There is no area "{area}". Add it in Settings → Areas, or leave it empty.
area.hidden: Area "{area}" is hidden. Show it again in Settings → Areas.

vc_number.box_needed: Plan, rent or start day is written but the VC number is empty.
vc_number.invalid: VC number: write only the letters and numbers printed on the card.
vc_number.repeated: This VC number is also on line {line}.
vc_number.in_use_until: This VC is with customer {code}. It can start here from {from}.
vc_number.in_use_other: This VC is with another customer.
vc_number.retired: This VC is out of service.

plan.plan_or_rent: Write the plan name or the rent for this box.
plan.not_found: There is no plan "{plan}". Check the name in Settings → Plans, or write the rent instead.
plan.retired: Plan "{plan}" is hidden. Show it again in Settings → Plans, or write another plan or the rent.

rent.rent_differs: The plan's rent is {amount}. Leave the rent empty, or leave the plan empty to use your own rent.
rent.decimal: Rent: write whole rupees, without paise.
rent.invalid: Rent: write a number of rupees, like 450.
rent.too_large: Rent is too big. Check the number.

start_date.invalid: Start day: write the day like 15/10/2026.
start_date.in_future: Start day can't be after tomorrow.
start_date.billed_period: Bills for that month are already made. Use a later start day.

line.too_many_boxes: A customer can have at most 10 connections (VC).
line.same_customer: Not added: line {lines} of the same customer has a problem.
line.not_saved: This customer could not be added. Upload the file again to try again.

any.differs: {field} is different on line {line} of the same customer. Write it once, on the first line.

help.title: How to fill the Customers sheet
help.line: One line for each set-top box (VC). A customer with 2 boxes = 2 lines with the same customer code.
help.needed: Customer code and Name are needed. Write the name, mobile, address and area on the customer's first line.
help.phone: Mobile no.: the 10 digits. Other columns can be empty.
help.area: Area: the name as it is in Settings → Areas.
help.plan: For each box: the VC number, and the Plan name as it is in Plans or the Rent in whole rupees.
help.date: Start day: like 15/10/2026. Empty means today.
help.again: Customers already in the app (same customer code) are not changed. Uploading the same file again is safe.
